facts.trace: $7BBE-$7BDB clears eleven bytes, then writes speed 4, reserves 6 and threshold $002710.
facts.selected_claim: $7BAF initializes zero totals, threshold 10,000, speed 4 and six reserves: seven lives including the current one.

facts.trace: $2932-$293E indexes separate low/high tables with mode 1-4.
facts.selected_claim: $29FF-$2A06 awards 100/250/500/750 per life for modes 1-4.

facts.trace: $2B5A-$2B82 writes five columns per row; $2B83 calls it for heights $08,$0A,$0C.
facts.selected_claim: Completion buildings $2A60/$2B83 are five cells wide and 8/10/12 high.

facts.trace: $2C00 accepts every sixteenth callback; ranges from $2B42/$2B46 select pairs at offsets 0 and 2.
facts.selected_claim: $2C00 flashes 4/5/6/all 15 window pairs for modes 1/2/3/4.

facts.trace: $5E78 clears 512 bytes; $5EA2 counts 30, $5E97/$5EC2 count 8; pointers advance 30/64.
facts.selected_claim: $5E6F expands eight consecutive 30-byte frames into eight 64-byte slots, leaving 34 zero bytes per slot; it reads 240 source bytes without a count or terminator.

facts.trace: $24BE masks candidate bit 7; BCC skips lower, BEQ compares next digit; all six equal skips record.
facts.selected_claim: Insertion $24A8 requires a strictly greater candidate; equal scores remain below existing ties.

facts.trace: $6000 submits all three descriptors. With all voices occupied, $45DA-$45E1 cannot preempt any positive priority with zero. An idle voice may receive an inactive zero-priority descriptor.
facts.selected_claim: Tune IDs 9/11/12/13 are identical zero-priority definitions: they do not silence occupied voices.

facts.trace: $9443 BNE enters title processing; $99DE BEQ enters demo processing.
facts.selected_claim: $9440 feeds title input triples on player pulses; demo $99DB runs on the opposite player-pulse phase.

facts.trace: $9ABE-$9ACC dispatches four opcodes; $9AE6 advances four bytes and processes next command immediately; $83 retains its pointer.
programs: call supplied sound wrapper then stop
facts.selected_claim: $9A98 interprets actor records: $80 loads frame pairs/color, $81 sets position/enables, $82 calls a sound wrapper, $83 stops; other four-byte records specify signed movement and duration.

facts.trace: $9B1D LDY #$80; store then DEY/BNE visits 128..1, omitting 0.
facts.selected_claim: The demo frame loader clears offsets 1 through 128 of a 128-byte workspace, including one byte beyond its end.

facts.trace: $3336/$3339/$333C increment Y; compare $D8 at $337E triggers expansion and shifts X left 12. Fall path requires hazard pulse and life !=2.
facts.selected_claim: Falling hazards fall three pixels per update at $3336, and expand into impact animation at $3385.

facts.trace: Every record calls $3317; equality with 3 resets the bomb divider, then caps the activation count at 3 from its zero initial state.
facts.selected_claim: Every third collected bomb activates another hunter, capped at three ($3317, counters $3454/$3455).

facts.trace: $3368 caches pre-move half-X; movement precedes $33E0 row compare, which uses updated Y. $340F compares cached half-X.
facts.qualification: Row uses post-move Y; half-X uses pre-move X. Equality of rows has priority.
facts.selected_claim: $33E0 turns toward the player only on exact row or half-X alignment.

facts.trace: $5611 fetches the real record callback; $5646 calls it before $565C adds ordinary 100 points. Private callback adds $0190.
facts.selected_claim: Four special records call $3282 for an extra 400 before the resident 100, totaling 500.

facts.trace: Header hooks 0,0,0,$308F; init/cleanup and all record callbacks use RTS $301F; global callback zero; foreground only uses resident spawn/collection.
facts.limit: No private moving callback is installed; resident perimeter bullets remain active.
facts.selected_claim: This overlay installs the standard collision callback $308F and no private moving-hazard routine.

facts.trace: $31FC requires enabled slot7, hazard pulse, life!=2. Latched contact resets a three-contact divider; $3269 queues $3288. Foreground $3053-$305D draws/clears pointer.
facts.labelFinding: The baseline routine name incorrectly identifies the preceding RTS at $31FB.
facts.selected_claim: Its IRQ $31FC advances Y by three and periodically queues erase/girder edits in stream $3288; main loop $3050 renders those edits outside the interrupt.

facts.trace: $33CB AND #3 / BEQ skips phase 0; nonzero effect Y required; reaching frame $15 hides it.
facts.selected_claim: Animation $33C8 advances the effect on three of every four raster services.

facts.trace: $316B masks random byte to 0..31; $316D rejects >=18; $3175 rejects occupied; $3193 counts 12 successful distinct draws.
facts.limit: Returning seeds checked; this is not a termination proof for all RNG states.
facts.selected_claim: Initialization $3161 randomly occupies 12 of 18 bomb locations.

facts.trace: $5611 fetches the real record callback; $5646 calls it before $565C adds ordinary 100 points. Private callback adds $0190.
facts.selected_claim: Four special records reach $3667, adding 400 before the resident 100 for 500 total.

facts.trace: $3301 tests same row first; otherwise contact selects movement index0, no contact3/4. $334C resets only if unsigned prospective Y<4.
